narrationTexts: Confirmed pattern matches migrated files exactly. Applying the same three-line transform to each of the 12 remaining files.
Verifying no stray `db.query` calls remain outside vendor code.
finalText:
**Migration done.** Moved 12 files, 36 calls, from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

One holdout stays: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) still calls `db.query`. It's a vendored file marked "do not edit, replaced wholesale on every upgrade" so I left it.

Next: flag that adapter to whoever owns the legacy-orm upgrade, since `db.query` is slated for removal.
